in_marathi.name: Kulbhushan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Power of the God Kul
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kulbhushan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from 'Kul' and 'Bhusan'. 'Kul' refers to the god Kul and 'Bhusan' means adorned or ornamented with. This name is believed to bring the blessings of the god Kul, who is worshipped for his power and protection.

in_bengali.name: Kulbhushan
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Power of the God Kul
in_bengali.long_meaning: Kulbhushan একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from 'Kul' and 'Bhusan'. 'Kul' refers to the god Kul and 'Bhusan' means adorned or ornamented with. This name is believed to bring the blessings of the god Kul, who is worshipped for his power and protection.
